decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the takeaway shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or a ramp of a gradient not less than 1:20 between the pavement and the floor, and a door handle not more than 1m above ground level.  Glass entrance doors and glazed screens must be clearly defined with manifestation on the glass at two levels: 850mm to 1000mm and 1400mm to 1600mm. The manifestation should be a sign or logo at least 150mm high spaced horizontally at intervals no less than 10cm.
description: Alterations to shopfront, installation of 2 satellite dishes and air conditioning units.
